name: Navigation, Workbenches, Draft State, Undo, Responsive UI
transaction_boundaries: UI interaction state, navigation state, query caches and Undo affordances are non-authoritative client state and never mutate domain truth.

Recoverable working-copy checkpoints are LLD-10-owned persistence only; each checkpoint/discard uses one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork and one COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 receipt and can never call an owning-domain mutation.
Accepted domain changes always use the owning packet route/command and current revision/fingerprint; LLD-10 never writes another packet's tables.
Deliberate-hold completion can request a session-bound LLD-12 proof but never authorizes the target command by itself.
failure_modes: stale query response is discarded by query identity and cannot replace current options/results
working-copy checkpoint failure preserves the in-memory edit and exposes recovery-degraded state without false save/acceptance
stale accepted revision produces conflict review and never last-write-wins
hold cancellation, route/target/revision change or failed proof generation produces no domain command
responsive reflow or pane switching cannot discard active record, selection, working copy or communication context
unsupported required browser capability fails visibly before the affected interaction is enabled
review_evidence: HLD-11 interaction-state, working-copy, responsive, confirmation and accessibility authority imported without domain-authority transfer.
Frontend framework/build stack selected at LLD layer rather than Architecture/HLD layer.
Recoverable working-copy persistence has exact command/query/route/audit contracts and bounded 5-second-idle/30-second-minimum checkpoint cadence.
Construction tests now include 40 acceptance and 20 failure-injection cases.
LLD-09 communication-panel dependency and LLD-12 deliberate-action proof remain explicit provider seams and cannot be inferred by LLD-10.
pending_native_v2_closure: exact LLD-12 deliberate-action proof route/type and anti-forgery handshake
domain-specific workbench projection/command composition maps against LLD-03/05/06/07/08
final requirement/reverse-orphan traceability and construction integrity cleanup
design_principle: The UI may preserve context, working intent and presentation state, but only owning-domain commands can change accepted operational truth.
